subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now, using doctor repair and temporarily disabling active OTLP signals, rather than implement a gRPC exporter?
rationale: The code can safely implement either direction, but only an owner can authorize removing a shipped config value and requiring operator repair during upgrade.

options.title: Approve retirement and migration
options.body: Accept HTTP/protobuf as the sole supported config value, retain the doctor migration, then rebase and require passing exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Preserve the gRPC contract
options.body: Do not merge this contract-narrowing PR and instead sponsor a real gRPC exporter path before changing validation or documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve retirement and migration
recommendation.body: Accept HTTP/protobuf as the sole supported config value, retain the doctor migration, then rebase and require passing exact-head checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to current configuration contracts and doctor migration policy.
